restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมบ้านหมอพีร์ Dr. P Dental | Pattaya
text: This place is the worst. I fixed my retainer yesterday and today I have something pricking me inside my mouth. The job was not done properly. I called them today to make an appointment and they wanted to charge me more money. Then they said if I visit the same dentist there is no fee. But to my surprise they wanted me to wait 16 days to see the same dentist. Don't waste your time and money here. Their prices are ridiculous. Charged 3700 baht for 10 minutes of work that was badly done with terrible follow up service.

text: I wasn't very happy with the reception staff (some of them). I called to inquire about details, and before I could even finish, the person on the line told me to leave, saying, "That's all for now, I don't have time to talk, go away." I was very upset. (The tone sounded like an older person.) Please look into this. I also work in customer service, and if customers encounter that kind of tone and language, no one wants to use the service. I didn't say anything disrespectful to you. Overall, the clinic is okay, but the attitude of some of the assistants needs improvement. I don't know who you were angry at, but you should differentiate between personal and professional matters. Thank you.
